results.title: GRIT - Official Launch Trailer
results.description: Take a look at the Launch Trailer for GRIT, a third-person Wild West battle royale shooter developed by Team GRIT. Players will drop into 100-player matches to explore the sprawling map where the game's inventory is also a poker hand. Match the right suits with weapons to gain perks and mind the incoming Calamity in GRIT, available now for PC (Steam).

results.title: Nord Stream blast film crew suspect detained in Croatia
results.description: A man reportedly part of a Hollywood film crew making a movie about the Nord Stream attacks has been remanded in Croatia over alleged involvement in the blasts.
